text:
laura: quick PSA — found a parity bug in the CLI fncall helper when using jsonMode + enum schemas. JS helper coerces numbers to strings and accepts them; py rejects.

laura: repro snippet:
```js
const helper = makeFnCallHelper({
  name: 'set_priority',
  arguments_schema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: { priority: { type: 'string', enum: ['low','med','high'] } },
    required: ['priority']
  },
  coerceTypes: true
})
// model returns 2 (number) in jsonMode -> helper coerces to '2' -> enum check compares string '2' and passes incorrectly
```

sasha: thanks, this explains the sample-app DB issue. Did we add coercion to helpers to be forgiving for text parsing? jsonMode should be authoritative about types.

kevin: JS helper was implemented to coerce loose user input; we forgot to skip coercion when jsonMode is enabled. Py did strict path.

jamie: short-term: set coerceTypes=false in sample-app scaffolds when jsonMode=true. Long-term: add strictEnums flag and default it off but lint warn when coerceTypes + jsonMode are both set.

laura: opened DEVEX-1127 to track: will patch scaffold, add integration test that simulates numeric outputs and assert enum validation fails, and add CLI lint rule.

devex-bot: Ticket DEVEX-1127 created and assigned to laura. https://tracker.internal/DEVEX-1127

sasha: also add a docs note in SDK migration guide: "If you use enums with jsonMode, disable coercion or enable strictEnums to avoid silent acceptance of wrong types."

kevin: will prepare a small PR to change helper flow: if jsonMode === true -> run parse -> enforce strict validation (no coercion) -> then retries. This should avoid double-encode + coercion interactions.

jamie: good call. label `devex:fncall-schema` and moving to triage. will re-run sample-app after patch.
